card.name: Last digit of ZIP codes
card.fires_on: The final digit of a five-digit US ZIP code in a mailing address, where a hyphen and four more digits may follow. Also colour-adjective endings like -ish or -uish before a hyphen, and the last digit of a year before a range dash.

modes.label: ZIP code end
modes.description: Last digit of a ZIP code in a postal address, just before a possible hyphen and ZIP+4 extension.

modes.label: Colour word ending
modes.description: Ending of a colour adjective such as bluish or reddish that is followed by a hyphen or a second colour.

modes.label: Year before range
modes.description: Last digit of a year that is followed by a dash and the end year of a range.

card.writes: It promotes hyphens and dashes as the next character, as in ZIP+4 extensions and ranges.
card.plain: It fires on the last digit of a ZIP code or the end of a colour word, when a hyphen is likely to come next.
